title: Fynaptix · Quantum Computing Research
heading: Quantum Computing Intelligence
subheading: Pure-plays, hedged giants & the road to commercial advantage
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Quantum pure-plays trade at extreme valuations (P/S ~72–611×) and are highly speculative — position sizing matters more here than anywhere else on this hub. Verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

tiers.label: Hedged Giants — Quantum as an Option
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list. Most quantum systems remain in R&D; true commercial systems are likely years away.

rows.angle: With U. Chicago & Algorithmiq, published the sector's first independently verified quantum advantage (Jul 30) — 70 logical qubits, 2,415 logical two-qubit ops, error rates 10x below physical; confirmed its first named external 120-qubit Nighthawk QPU deployment (Yonsei University, live by Nov 2026); on Aug 19 connected its first two modular cryogenic systems (cooled below 15 millikelvin), a concrete engineering step toward the 2029 Quantum Starling fault-tolerant target and a planned 1,000+ qubit modular architecture
rows.watch for: Kookaburra qLDPC rollout; 2027 deployment of the new modular cryostat architecture; independent replication of the advantage claim; pace of the Nighthawk fleet rollout

rows.angle: Willow: below-threshold error correction confirmed as grid scaled 3×3→5×5→7×7; new reinforcement-learning calibration framework autonomously stabilizes logical qubits during continuous operation; opened Willow cloud access to the UK's National Quantum Computing Centre and deepened its NVIDIA CUDA-Q collaboration to simulate noise in next-gen chip designs (week of Aug 11) — no incremental catalyst since
rows.watch for: Gate-operation demos beyond memory preservation; output from the UK NQCC access program

rows.angle: Topological qubit program + Azure Quantum; Quantinuum/Microsoft collab reports 800× logical-vs-physical qubit fidelity on System Model H2
rows.watch for: Majorana milestone reproducibility (independent critiques of the topological-qubit claim persist); Quantinuum's Aug 11 post-IPO print (revenue $8M, +279% YoY, but a $597M GAAP loss) as an early, noisy read-through on the partnership

rows.angle: NVQLink (built on CUDA-Q, announced Aug 17) — a universal GPU–QPU interconnect adopted by 17 quantum hardware builders (incl. Rigetti, SEEQC, Silicon Quantum Computing) and 9 national/scientific labs, incl. Quantinuum's Helios and QuEra; no new hardware partners added this week
rows.watch for: NVQLink adoption at national labs; hybrid quantum-AI workloads

private_watchlist.name: PsiQuantum
private_watchlist.note: Reportedly closed a $1.5B round (May 2026) at a ~$10.5B valuation; broke ground on its Moreton Bay Central fault-tolerant facility in Australia; expanded its DARPA agreement to $125M as one of only two firms in Stage C, the final validation stage of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative. Appointed Skype co-founder and Atomico founder Niklas Zennström to its board (mid-Aug), succeeding Siraj Khaliq, following the new Peng/Soderbery/Sitaraman leadership team and a $250K South Chicago quantum-workforce investment.

private_watchlist.name: Quantinuum
private_watchlist.note: Honeywell-backed; upsized $1.68B IPO raise at $60/share (~$12.7B valuation). Reported its first post-IPO quarter Aug 11: revenue $8M (+279% YoY) but a GAAP net loss of $597M, largely IPO-related stock comp, against $2.1B cash; FY26 revenue guidance set at $28–32M. Announced a multi-year Oracle partnership placing its Helios trapped-ion system (98 physical qubits, 48 logical qubits demonstrated, 99.921% two-qubit gate fidelity) inside an Oracle Cloud Infrastructure AI data center, plus a workforce MOU with the Singapore Institute of Technology. On Aug 20 secured $1.5M in city/state LEDA funding to expand a ~13,000 sq. ft. integrated-photonics R&D center in Albuquerque (25 new jobs, first phase complete by year-end). Shares remain choppy post-IPO as the market digests the burn rate against the roadmap (Sol 2027 → Apollo 2029 → Lumos 2030s).

private_watchlist.name: QuEra
private_watchlist.note: $230M+ raise backed by Google Quantum AI, SoftBank, NVentures; 96 verified logical qubits — industry-leading; NVIDIA CUDA-Q/NVQLink integration partner. Outlined a gigaquop-class fault-tolerant roadmap targeting 2028–2029 (1,000+ logical qubits, 20,000+ physical qubits, ~1 billion reliable logical operations), and partnered with Zapata Quantum (Aug 12) to identify enterprise use cases and benchmark hybrid algorithms ahead of its megaquop-class, fault-tolerant neutral-atom QPU on AWS by 2028.

bear_case.title: Years from commercial advantage
bear_case.description: Most systems remain R&D-phase; revenue today is mostly government contracts and research access, not commercial workloads.

bear_case.title: Valuations price in perfection — and swing hard on macro, not fundamentals
bear_case.description: The pure-play trio fell as much as ~13% over three sessions (Aug 18–20) purely on rising Treasury yields, then rebounded 8–11.5% in a single Friday session (Aug 21) with no new company news either way. P/S multiples of ~72–611× still price in years of flawless execution, and that kind of round-trip on macro noise alone is a feature of the trade, not a bug.

bear_case.title: Insiders aren't buying
bear_case.description: Insiders at IonQ, Rigetti and D-Wave have collectively sold ~$988M in stock over five years versus roughly $4.3M in insider purchases combined (as of Jul 22, 2026) — a persistent gap between executive selling and executive conviction. Rigetti's COO and CFO both sold shares again this week (Aug 20–21), albeit routine RSU tax-withholding sales rather than discretionary trades.

bear_case.title: Dilution as a business model
bear_case.description: Pure-plays fund R&D via repeated equity raises; share counts grow relentlessly. CHIPS Act awards to Rigetti, D-Wave and others are structured partly as government equity stakes — another layer of dilution on top. Quantinuum's own first post-IPO quarter posted a $597M GAAP net loss against $8M revenue — a reminder that a large IPO cushion buys time, not immunity from burn.

bear_case.title: Winner may not be listed
bear_case.description: IBM/Google/Microsoft or private PsiQuantum could reach fault tolerance first, stranding pure-play premiums. Quantinuum is now listed (Nasdaq: QNT) but its economics remain closer to a pre-revenue R&D story than a commercial one.

catalysts.title: Sector snaps back after three-day, yield-driven slide
catalysts.description: IonQ +8.0%, Rigetti +11.5%, D-Wave +8.5% in a single session — a mechanical rebound after Treasury yields, not company news, drove a ~13% three-day drawdown (Aug 18–20). Same day, BMO Capital initiated D-Wave at Outperform with a $35 price target.

catalysts.title: Quantinuum expands Albuquerque R&D footprint
catalysts.description: $1.5M in city/state LEDA funding backs a ~13,000 sq. ft. integrated-photonics lab, creating 25 jobs and deepening ties to Sandia, Los Alamos and the University of New Mexico.

catalysts.title: IBM connects its first modular cryogenic systems
catalysts.description: Two cryostat modules joined and cooled below 15 millikelvin in under five days — a practical engineering step toward linking hundreds of quantum chips and building IBM Quantum Starling, targeted for 2029.

catalysts.title: Rigetti creates COO role, new Systems Delivery unit
catalysts.description: A dedicated Systems Delivery organization and a new Chief Operating Officer will lead manufacturing, deployment and customer-facing engineering as demand grows for on-prem systems from 9-qubit Novera to 108-qubit Cepheus-class machines.

catalysts.title: D-Wave / NTT DOCOMO deploy second production app
catalysts.description: The new quantum-powered application cut location-registration signaling by 65.3% at daily peak and paging signals by 7.0% — a concrete, quantifiable commercial win rather than a pilot or bookings figure.

catalysts.title: Senate NDAA push for quantum funding
catalysts.description: Sen. Todd Young is seeking to attach a National Quantum Initiative reauthorization to the NDAA — ~$85M/year in NIST QIST funding through FY2030 plus $25M for NASA — running in parallel to the House's proposed 68% defense-quantum R&D increase.

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: IBM
positions.note: IBM's modular cryogenic milestone (Aug 19) — two cryostats joined and cooled below 15 millikelvin — is a concrete engineering step toward Quantum Starling (2029), stacked on last month's verified quantum-advantage claim and the incoming Nighthawk deployment at Yonsei. Quantum remains a rounding error on a profitable, dividend-paying business.

positions.name: Alphabet
positions.note: No incremental catalyst since the UK NQCC access and CUDA-Q noise-simulation news two weeks ago; Willow's below-threshold error correction claim stands unchallenged. Also your largest AI-sleeve holding — size the sector weight with that overlap in mind, don't double-count.

positions.name: Microsoft
positions.note: Quiet week for Microsoft's own quantum program; the clearest read-through remains Quantinuum's mixed Aug 11 print ($8M revenue, $597M GAAP loss). Microsoft's own exposure is immaterial to its financials either way. Also held in the AI sleeve — avoid double-counting.

positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.note: NVQLink's 17-builder, 9-lab standardization thesis is unchanged this week; no new hardware partners added since the Aug 17 launch. Also your largest cross-sector AI holding — size for that concentration, not just the quantum optionality.

positions.name: IonQ
positions.note: Shares round-tripped a ~13% three-day slide (Aug 18-20) and an 8% Friday rebound driven entirely by Treasury yields, not company news; the new CMC Microsystems Canada deal is incremental, not thesis-changing. Trimmed one point given the pure macro-beta behavior this week, not a change in stance.

positions.name: Rigetti
positions.note: The new COO role and Systems Delivery organization (Aug 19) is an organizational move, not a revenue one — TTM revenue is still $13.4M against a $6.0B market cap (P/S ~448x). Trimmed slightly; no operating catalyst this week beyond the reorg.

positions.name: D-Wave
positions.note: Upgraded from Watch: NTT DOCOMO's second production deployment (Aug 18) — a real telco cutting network signaling load 65.3% — is the first genuinely repeatable commercial use case among the pure-plays, and BMO's new Outperform initiation ($35 PT, Aug 21) agrees. Still sized small: TTM revenue is just $12.4M against a P/S of ~611x, and the bookings-vs-revenue gap hasn't closed.

positions.name: Quantinuum
positions.note: Quiet week for the newest listed name here: a $1.5M Albuquerque R&D expansion (Aug 20) is a minor state-incentive item next to last week's Oracle OCI placement. FY26 guidance of $28-32M revenue against a $12.7B IPO valuation remains the open question keeping this in Watch, not Core.
